messages:
tom_prod_mgr: Hey people-ops — need an exception routed. Candidate (Lina) is a strong IC hire for Core Search. We're at band S4 but she asked and received a counter at another firm. Manager recommends: equity uplift to 0.5% (above S4 target), plus a one-time retention bonus $30k. Also requests a partial ramp: first 4 weeks 60% FTE to finish notice period at current employer.
eli_recruiter: candidate verbally accepted pending comp + start date clarity. Start target: May 15 but we might need to push to June 1 because of payroll cutoff.
anita_peopleops: Thanks — a couple clarifying q's: is $30k sign-on taxable cash or deferred? and is the equity uplift permanent target change or one-off grant?
tom_prod_mgr: sign-on = taxable cash, paid in first paycheck. equity = one-off upfront grant on top of normal hire RSUs (so not a permanent band change).
maria_finance: FYI payroll cutoff for June payroll closes May 20. If start after May 20, first pay hits June 30. Budget impact: comp + bonus runs ~ $78k first-year expense incl payroll taxes and equity accrual; need BU confirm funding.
sara_comp: Quick note: upward equity exceptions >0.25% require comp committee sign-off; cash sign-ons >$20k require finance and people-ops OK. Also need to check manager comp plan for headcount-level precedents.
comp-approvals-bot: Automated check: Required approvers = [sara_comp, maria_finance, kevin_cto]. Please include link to completed comp form: https://redwood-internal/hr/comp-forms/3412345678 (fill template).
eli_recruiter: Filling form now, attaching candidate scorecard and market comp doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx
anita_peopleops: If committee is reluctant we can propose alternative: $15k cash sign-on + 0.25% uplift now + 0.25% deferred vest over 12 months (cliff). That reduces FY cash burden and keeps candidate tied. Thoughts?
kevin_cto: technical agrees hiring bar justifies strong offer, but prefer more RSU vs cash. Can we do $20k cash + 0.4% total equity with 25% deferred?
maria_finance: That split looks workable from budget POV. Need final numbers to update headcount forecast and submit cap table accrual.
sara_comp: Please attach final comp form with the alternate structure as a fallback. If manager insists on original ask, I'll route to comp committee for Thurs review.
tom_prod_mgr: I'll submit the form with both structures and indicate candidate prefers original offer but is okay with the alt. Also confirm they can start part-time ramp May 15 and full-time June 1.
comp-approvals-bot: Submission received. Routing to approvers: sara_comp, maria_finance, kevin_cto. Committee escalation will occur if any approver requests. ETA for decision: 72 hours.
eli_recruiter: tagging Lina that we may need 72 hrs for approvals. she appreciated transparency. :thumbsup:
anita_peopleops: Noted—I'll pencil a start date contingency in offer letter for payroll/benefits eligibility (medical waiting period, prorated vacation accrual).
kevin_cto: Approving in principle — will sign formal approval after seeing filled form.
sara_comp: Understood — I'll review the form now.
maria_finance: On calendar to sign off today if numbers match.
tom_prod_mgr: Thanks all. Please ping me for any questions. :wave:
